name: ungoogled-chromium
summary: Chromium with the Google integration removed

config.notes: The user-data directory has the same layout on both platforms: Preferences, Bookmarks, extensions and per-profile directories all carry over. Cookies and saved passwords are sealed with the Windows DPAPI, so those are re-entered on Linux; they are secrets anyway and travel only with --secrets. It shares the user-data directory name with plain Chromium, so only one of the two should be restored into it.
